entries.spec_requirement_id: knowledge-server/A stdlib-only MCP knowledge server exists
scenarios: entry point exercised by a test
acceptance_criteria: services/knowledge_server/ ships a JSON-RPC-over-stdio server (initialize/tools/list/tools/call) hand-implemented, no mcp SDK import (grep)
check_separation() passes over the new package (test)
a test drives the stdio loop end-to-end initialize->tools/list->tools/call (the deng launch-dead-main refusal)
no LLM/network call in the package (grep + separation)
a source-adapter interface exists; DictionarySource mounts search_dictionary/get_table_details/find_relations/get_dictionary_status from a data-dictionary.json fixture
MapSource mounts search_map/get_route_details/find_call_paths/get_map_status from a lineage+frontmatter fixture
a test asserts no source artifact file is written by any tool call

entries.spec_requirement_id: knowledge-server/find_call_paths generalizes deng's join-path query over the lineage edge vocabulary
scenarios: a call path is returned from the real graph
acceptance_criteria: find_call_paths walks only edges present in lineage-graph.json (calls/reads/writes/modifies/serves/originates/serves_route); a fixture with outbound edges returns the reachable path; invented edges are impossible (test over a fixture)

entries.spec_requirement_id: knowledge-server/Every tool response carries a freshness verdict
acceptance_criteria: every tool response (not only status tools) carries {verdict in current|stale|unknowable, basis[]}
map staleness computed by hooks/lineage_graph.py::transitive_stale_nodes over paths changed since the stamp + map_invalidated (test with a stale fixture -> stale)
dictionary DB currency reported unknowable without a live connection; never a fabricated current; never a bare wall clock (test)

entries.spec_requirement_id: knowledge-server/Ranked search composes the Librarian index
scenarios: search returns ranked results via the shared index
acceptance_criteria: search_dictionary/search_map compose services/librarian/library_index.py::LibraryIndex (verifiable by import, not re-implemented); results ranked by its weighting (test)

each tool's response shape built + validated with scripts/mcp_design/output_contract.py build_output_contract/validate_against_contract; a test asserts a malformed response FAILS validation (the check is falsifiable)
a bg_runtime.Scheduler tick re-indexes when a sidecar mtime/hash changes; a test shows subsequent tool calls reflect the new content

'serving' is printed ONLY after a real live tools/call round-trip against the started server (confirm_gateway_serving bar); described 'serving on this machine' never 'deployed' (test)

testing_authorizations.playwright: n/a - authorized: the target is the CT6 plugin (stdlib services + CLI); the knowledge server has NO web UI. Its user-experience layer IS its stdio/JSON-RPC tool behavior + the installer's live round-trip, verified by pytest driving the stdio loop end-to-end + the confirm-serving round-trip (the equivalent of a real-backend integration test).
testing_authorizations.dev_api_integration: n/a - authorized: no HTTP API; the MCP stdio server is exercised in-process by the entry-point tests and by the installer's live tools/call confirmation (the real-serving check).
testing_authorizations.both_layer_integration: n/a - all entries layer infra by the repo convention.
